semantics.timing: Continuous combinational connections; no clock or cycle latency. Outputs track current inputs after combinational settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization; outputs are determined by current inputs.

numeric.simulation: Direct connections propagate 0, 1, X and Z without transformation.

verification.plan: Independently drive all eight binary input combinations and all 64 four-state combinations; check each output against its specified source using case inequality after settling.
verification.oracle: w equals a, x equals b, y equals b, z equals c.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp.
verification.termination: Finite compile and simulation shell timeouts plus testbench watchdog.
verification.scope: Development checks only; no official evaluation, synthesis or board claims.
